title: Version 2.1.80 - Enhanced Status Line and Plugin Controls
description: Added rate_limits field to statusline scripts for displaying Claude.ai rate limit usage (5-hour and 7-day windows), source: 'settings' plugin marketplace source for inline plugin declaration in settings.json, CLI tool usage detection for plugin tips, effort frontmatter support for skills/slash commands, and --channels research preview for MCP server message pushing. Fixed numerous bugs including --resume dropping parallel tool results, voice mode WebSocket failures, and 400 errors with fine-grained tool streaming through API proxies. Improved @ file autocomplete responsiveness and reduced memory usage on startup by ~80MB on large repositories.

community_feedback.quote: #ClaudeCode is all you need in 2026. Claude Code in 2026 is not what it was when it launched. After a year of building frameworks, custom tools, and more
Hooks let you run code automatically before or after Claude makes changes. Running Prettier on every file Claude touches
⚠️ Important warning: If you Google 'install Claude Code,' the top result is malware. Attackers are buying Google Ads for fake Claude Code installers

title: Composer 2 Release - Frontier-Level Coding Performance
description: Released Composer 2 with frontier-level coding performance improvements. Introduced Automations feature for building always-on agents that can handle repetitive tasks. Added 30+ new plugins from major partners including Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, and PlanetScale. Extended IDE support to JetBrains through ACP. Launched MCP Apps and Team Marketplaces for enhanced collaboration and extensibility.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor is usable but has medium-level styling issues. There are still trust concerns with AI-generated code.
Cursor research shows 50% reduction in compaction errors with Composer 2.

title: Copilot CLI Version 1.0.4 - Enhanced Observability and Shell Integration
description: Released Copilot CLI version 1.0.4 with OpenTelemetry instrumentation for observability into agent sessions, LLM calls, and tool executions. Added session.shell.exec and session.shell.kill RPC methods for executing shell commands with streaming output. Introduced adaptive color engine with dynamic color modes and interactive theme picker. Added configure-copilot sub-agent for managing MCP servers, custom agents, and skills. Fixed OAuth authentication for Microsoft Entra ID, improved /pr view command, and added --reasoning-effort CLI flag. Extensions can now be written as CommonJS modules. Version 1.0.3 introduced experimental Extensions feature allowing Copilot to write custom tools and hooks using @github/copilot-sdk.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot CLI lets you use all these models (unless your employer restricts access).
Security concerns discussed around malware execution vulnerabilities where approval gates could be bypassed.
What AI tools are actually worth trying beyond GitHub Copilot in 2026? It works well for us in our corporate environment.

title: GPT-5.4 Mini and Cascade Improvements - March 2026
description: Released GPT-5.4 Mini available in Windsurf starting at 1x credits with promotional pricing. Fixed Apple M5 compatibility issues. Improved Cascade with fixes for Jupyter Notebook diff zones and performance on WSL, enhanced UI rendering performance, and fixed agent panel crashes. Added support for loading SKILL.md files from .windsurf/skills/ directory. Enhanced MCP with system-level Skill definitions via MDM-managed configs for Enterprise and improved context management. Improved autocomplete error handling, SSH & Remote performance, and fixed model price change notifications. Version 1.9577.24 added SKILL.md support and AGENTS.md fixes.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf is actually the most generous IDE platform. I think people were scared to use it due to some reputational problems before.
I tested Windsurf, Cursor, and Claude Code on the same real project. The actual answer in 2026 is that most developers I know are running two or three AI IDEs.
Did Windsurf team stop innovating? Some user concerns about development pace.

title: Session Insights On-Demand and PWA Support - March 2026
description: Released March 13, 2026 update with Session Insights now generated on-demand rather than automatically after each session. Added ability to install Devin as a Progressive Web App from Chrome, Edge, or Safari for native app-like experience. Upgraded AskDevin to support both Ask and Plan modes with improved context understanding. Introduced Devin Review features including GitHub Commit Status Checks for pull request validation. Added Datadog MCP Integration for enhanced monitoring capabilities. Implemented Default Branch Management and Schedule: Run as User features. Added IdP Groups in Enterprise Settings for better team management. March 7, 2026 updates included Install Devin as App feature and expanded AskDevin capabilities.

community_feedback.quote: Where did Devin go? Some users expressing concerns about visibility and autonomy level of the AI agent.
Enterprise adoption of Devin is growing as teams seek autonomous AI agents for complex development workflows.
Mixed reactions to Devin's autonomous capabilities - some praise its independence while others prefer more control.
